recognize_zh: 骨髓 core 切片低倍下，骨小樑間被一片密集、單調的中小型圓核細胞彌漫取代，幾乎看不到脂肪及正常造血三系，上方可見疏鬆纖維間質；此為 BPDCN 骨髓彌漫浸潤的樣式，但需高倍與免疫染色確認。
features: Markedly hypercellular intertrabecular space with near-total loss of fat
Diffuse, monotonous infiltrate of small-to-intermediate cells with round dark nuclei and scant cytoplasm
Loss of normal trilineage hematopoiesis; megakaryocytes not identifiable at this power
Loose fibrous/edematous stroma with spindle cells at the upper portion of the field
Intact lamellar bony trabeculae without osteolysis
describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy (H&E, low power) shows a markedly hypercellular marrow space with near-total effacement of fat by a diffuse, monotonous infiltrate of small-to-intermediate cells with round hyperchromatic nuclei and scant cytoplasm. Normal trilineage hematopoiesis is not appreciated at this magnification, and an area of loose fibrous stroma is present at the upper aspect. The adjacent bony trabeculae are intact. The findings indicate extensive marrow replacement by a blastic or lymphoid neoplasm, compatible with blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm in conjunction with immunohistochemistry (CD4, CD56, CD123, TCF4).

ddx.vs: AML may show identical diffuse replacement at low power, and separation requires MPO/CD34/CD117 versus CD123/TCF4/CD56 immunostains.
Lymphoblasts form similar sheets but are TdT-positive with B- or T-lineage markers and CD123/CD56-negative.

ddx.dx: Small B-cell lymphoma (e.g., mantle cell or small lymphocytic)
ddx.vs: Mature lymphoma cells have coarser chromatin and often nodular/paratrabecular patterns, and express CD20 with cyclin D1 or CD5/CD23.
